name: Anatomy Learning Labs: Sensory Lab
summary:
Step into the Sensory Lab of the Anatomy Learning Labs series, where the systems of vision, hearing, smell, and taste come to life in stunning 3D. Featuring anatomically accurate models developed by medical professionals and learning activities designed by professors, the Sensory Lab teaches elementary, middle, and high school learners how sensory organs detect information and how the brain processes these signals into perception.

This app leverages the Quest's audio, visual, and hand-tracking capabilities
